title: One-Request Database Factory — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public systems knowledge, fact-checked reference. Converts a database requirement into schemas, import pipelines, indexes, validation, and query interfaces. Describe the database you need; the factory designs the schema, builds the import pipeline, creates indexes, adds validation, and ships a query interface. Framing: "God Mode" here means an ambitious engineering target — maximum useful capability, broad interoperability, deep automation, and rigorous verification — NOT unlimited intelligence or guaranteed success.
